$comment: The role assessment DOCUMENT shape, distinct from the check-output-envelope.json run envelope: this is `clossys/<role>/assessment.json` (docs/contracts/package-framework.json's `outputs`), the standing record of a role's own first-day assessment, using issue #533's required assessment output list verbatim. Contract only in this wave -- no package emits it yet.
path: clossys/<role>/assessment.json, where <role> is the manifest's own package name with its scope removed

requiredFrom533.baseline: current baseline and evidence quality -- { value, unit, evidenceSource, evidenceQuality: "strong" | "weak" | "absent", observedAt }
requiredFrom533.target: target state and setpoint -- { setpoint, unit, direction: "increase" | "decrease" | "maintain" | "target-range", windowDays }
requiredFrom533.gaps: material gaps and causal hypothesis -- array of { description, causalHypothesis }
requiredFrom533.unknowns: unknowns and decision questions -- array of { question, decisionOwnerRef }
requiredFrom533.criticalPath: critical path, dependencies, and optional refinements -- { steps: array of { description, dependsOn: string[] }, optionalRefinements: string[] }
requiredFrom533.authority: authority, budget, guardrails, and escalation path -- { decisionOwnerRef, budget, guardrails: string[], escalationPath }
requiredFrom533.proposedPositions: proposed installed positions and worker mix -- array of { positionId, roleRef, workerMix: string[] }

rule: Every field in `requiredFrom533` is present; a role that has not yet formed an opinion on one records it as an explicit empty collection (`gaps: []`, `unknowns: []`) or an explicit `evidenceQuality: "absent"` baseline, never by omitting the field -- omission here means undeclared, not resolved, exactly as docs/contracts/check-output-envelope.json treats a missing `findings` array. `asOf` is a known-offset RFC3339 instant; a document whose `asOf` is not the most recent write is stale and must not be presented as current. This document is authored by the role itself -- @clossys/controller's onboarding orchestration never writes into it and carries it only by reference (see packages/controller/src/onboarding/types.ts, `RoleAssessmentRecord.assessment: unknown`).
